provenance.paper_title: Don't Just Listen, Try Planning: Graph-based Retrieval-Generation Agent for Long-form Audio Meeting Understanding

latest_version.version_label: ACL Anthology camera-ready (Findings of ACL 2026, pp. 20715-20742), reviewed 2026-08-30

representation_paths.memory_component: multi-dimensional heterogeneous meeting graph over utterance nodes (transcript, speaker identity, start/end timestamps, LLM-distilled speaker profile) with temporal, reply-to, same-speaker, entity and coreference-semantic edges

evidence.paraphrase: VAD + ASR + forced alignment turn the meeting audio into timestamped utterance nodes; ERes2NetV2 speaker embeddings and incremental clustering assign speaker IDs, and an LLM distills a structured speaker profile stored as a node attribute. The heterogeneous graph G=(V,E) adds temporal, reply-to, same-speaker, entity co-occurrence and LLM-detected coreference edges, and this graph is the environment the agent queries. Nodes carry timestamps and utterance IDs, so the underlying audio span is recoverable.

evidence.figure_or_table: Table 11 (atomic tools in the action space)
evidence.paraphrase: The planner issues keyword_search (BM25), semantic_search (dense retrieval), hybrid_search, filte_time_range, filte_speaker and traverse_relations over the graph, i.e. tool-mediated similarity, metadata and edge-traversal access rather than a single one-shot retrieval.

representation_paths.memory_component: retained raw meeting waveform, addressed by timestamp through the audio_segment tool

evidence.section: Appendix (Tools Details); 4 Experimentation (ablation and tool-usage analysis)
evidence.figure_or_table: Table 11 (audio_segment tool); Table 5 (ablation: w/o Tool: Audio Access, -14.78 accuracy on AMI)
evidence.paraphrase: audio_segment(t_start, t_end) 'retrieves raw waveform data to ground text in acoustic signals (e.g., for emotion detection)'. The tool-usage analysis states that acoustic-aware questions show a high frequency of Audio Access calls in the final steps, i.e. the agent listens to the retained raw audio when transcripts are insufficient; removing the tool causes the second-largest accuracy drop.

representation_paths.memory_component: agent belief state b_t = {query, decomposed constraints, interaction history H_t, accumulated evidence set, reflector critiques}

evidence.paraphrase: The task is cast as a POMDP whose belief state b_t, explicitly defined as the sufficient statistic for decision-making, is initialized from the decomposed query and updated by a deterministic transition b_{t+1} = psi(b_t, P_t, o_t) = b_t + {P_t, o_t}. Observations are textual evidence segments s_i = (text_i, time_i, spk_i) retained across planning iterations and consumed by the Answer Synthesizer with citations; utterance IDs and timestamps link each record back to the graph and audio.

evidence.section: 3.3 GRGA Planning Process (Environment Interaction: Tool Execution)
evidence.paraphrase: At every inference step the retained belief/evidence state is updated by a fixed deterministic transition function psi that appends the executed plan and the newly retrieved evidence; the memory content grows across steps while the update rule itself is fixed and training-free.

evidence.section: 3.3 GRGA Planning Process (Reward Estimation: Synthesis & Reflection)
evidence.figure_or_table: Equations 8-9; Figure 3 (Reliability Critique / Re-Plan & Update Belief); Table 5 (w/o Reflection, -9.84)
evidence.paraphrase: The Self-Reflector scores the entailment between accumulated evidence and the candidate answer; when the score falls below the threshold the negative critique is injected into the belief state (b_{t+1} <- b_{t+1} union {fb_t}), which revises the retained evidence/belief content and forces a corrective plan on the next iteration. The revision policy is a fixed prompted rule, not a learned one.

derived.hybrid_relation: The pre-built utterance graph, the timestamp-addressed raw waveform, and the accumulated textual belief/evidence state are deliberately linked (graph nodes carry the timestamps used to fetch audio, and both feed the same evidence set) and jointly supplied to the Answer Synthesizer.

adjudication_notes: Full camera-ready PDF read (text extracted locally). The multi-dimensional graph is explicitly 'pre-constructed' and serves as a fixed environment: it is only queried, never rewritten, so the graph alone would be T1.

T2 is assigned on the agent-side memory: the paper formalizes an explicit belief state with a deterministic transition function (Eq. 6) and reflector-driven critique injection (Eq. 9) that persists across planning iterations within an episode and is reused by the synthesizer. Alternative reading: this state could be treated as ordinary prompt/action history, which would place the system at T1; it is counted here because the architecture explicitly retains, formalizes and reuses it as operative memory.

No T3: the system is training-free ('the policy utilizes in-context reasoning to determine the next optimal action without parameter updates'); the reflector reward is a within-episode heuristic and no write/maintenance/retrieval policy artifact persists to later questions or meetings.
